# ManyBody_OrderOptimality

**Domain**: Cross

## Definition
A theoretical framework for determining the optimal ordering of interactions in multi-agent and many-body systems to minimize computational or physical resource usage. Provides a principled basis for designing efficient neuromorphic topologies where agent interactions must be sequenced optimally within constrained network resources.
